name: Barananu
description: Enjoy a free concert on the iconic terrace of Casa da Música, with this local sextet blending jazz, disco, and progressive rock.
longDescription:
Barananu presents a free musical performance by a Porto-based sextet, known for their distinctive fusion of jazz, disco, and progressive rock influences. This concert is part of a series of public events hosted at Casa da Música, designed to offer accessible cultural experiences to the local community and visitors. The group's instrumentation typically includes a blend of brass, rhythm section, and synthesizers, contributing to their genre-spanning sound.

Attendees will experience an outdoor concert on the expansive Terrace of Casa da Música, a prominent architectural landmark in Porto. The atmosphere is generally relaxed and welcoming, suitable for a diverse audience interested in contemporary music. The performance is expected to last approximately 60-90 minutes, providing an evening's entertainment against the backdrop of the city.

Admission to Barananu is free, and no prior booking is required; guests are welcome to arrive and find a spot on the terrace. Casa da Música is conveniently located near the Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F), a short walk from the venue entrance. The terrace area is generally accessible.
